name: COMP_035
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (62%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert

The reliability flag is on, and the conformal set spans three classes. [F6]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 62%, InSitu 26%, Normal 12% | Benign leads, InSitu second |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu | Three classes not separated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.05 / 74th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign | Neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest association against invasive carcinoma in the concept model [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Duct-confined atypia scores high; relevant to InSitu option · Weak
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Score below typical; descriptive only · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- The reliability flag reflects stain, blur or out-of-distribution artifact distorting all three probabilities.
- Four of five similar cases are Normal and the second model disagrees, so Normal may be correct.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: look for atypical cells confined within ducts (InSitu is in the set).
2. **Regions 7, 10, 11**: confirm normal lobules with two-layered epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 9**: highest per-region invasive probability (42%); look for tumor, lymphocytes, mitoses.
